responsibility: Defines the i386 target configuration for VxWorks, including ABI, preprocessor, linker, profiler, and CPU-macro policy. It selects different behavior for VxWorks 7 versus earlier releases, sets debugger register numbering, chooses CPU builtins for the active microarchitecture, and configures stack checking and runtime libraries so GCC can generate code and driver specs for the VxWorks environment.
